cycle_report.summary: Cycle 1 accomplished the complete merger of two StoryForge codebases (Home and Workspace) into a unified AI-StoryForge SaaS platform. The backend engine (sf_engine) was taken from Workspace with its superior multi-provider LLM support, cancellation, and structured logging. The authentication, billing, and session management came from Home. A full frontend was built with 17 Jinja2 templates (landing, auth, app, admin, emails), static CSS/JS assets, and a dark gradient glassmorphism theme. Admin dashboard with user management, project monitoring, and financials was created. Credits system (3 free on signup), Stripe billing integration, OAuth (Google/GitHub), email verification, and password reset flows were implemented. Docker deployment (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, nginx.conf) and portable .env configuration were set up. All 71 round-2 tests pass (41 functional + 30 adversarial). Security hardened: SQL injection, XSS, path traversal, negative credits, and email length validation all verified. Visual verification of 6 key pages confirmed correct rendering.
